On Sun, Aug 28, 2011 at 6:44 AM, rst9288 <rstri...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Hi,
>
> When I use system.time for any function with my R, I always get 0 for
> all the three columns i.e. user, system and elapsed. And I think this
> is a wrong behavior. but I am always getting zero.
>
> So what might be the issue?

The most probable that comes to mind is you are using it on trivial
calculations that, with rounding, take 0 seconds. If you do send the
question over to R-help, be sure to read the posting guide first and
(as it asks): include your version of R, and a reproducible example of
what you are doing (such as
x <- matrix(NA, nrow = 10^5, ncol = 2)
system.time(for(i in 1:10^5) x[i, ] <- c(mean(rnorm(i)), mean(runif(i))))
), and because you are dealing with timing issues, maybe even basic
information on your hardware.

Cheers,

Josh
